hints.title: WELCOME BACK
hints.text: The deep holds dangers - this lesson covers gravity and your tools. Head right!

hints.title: FALLING BOULDERS
hints.text: Boulders fall as soon as nothing holds them up. Dig along under these two and keep walking: each drops into the pit behind you. Never go straight down with a boulder above you - it follows and lands on you.

hints.title: PUSH IT
hints.text: Walk into a boulder to push it. Shove this one ahead - it will drop into the gap and clear your way.

hints.title: TOXIC BARREL
hints.text: Toxic barrels explode 3×3 when they fall or get hit. Push it into the pit and stand well back - the blast opens the vault below.

hints.title: DYNAMITE
hints.text: Grab the dynamite ahead! Press 1 to place a stick, then get clear: every step and every second burns the fuse, and it lasts for only five. The blast breaks earth, boulders and ice, but not solid rock.

hints.title: BOULDER PLUG
hints.text: Boulders plug the tunnel below - no room to push them. Place dynamite beside the plug and retreat up this shaft!

hints.title: THE KEY
hints.text: A key lies under the earth just ahead, below the tunnel. Dig down for it - the door stays locked without one.

hints.title: HELMET LAMP
hints.text: A helmet lamp lies in the alcove ahead. Press 2 to light it: for 12 seconds you see twice as far. Handy in the huge deep mines!

hints.title: LOCKED DOOR
hints.text: A door uses up one key when you walk into it. Unlock this one to enter the final vault.

hints.title: FINAL VAULT
hints.text: Dig out the last element, then step onto the exit hatch to finish the lesson.
